boundary: Explicit empty private NETRC + PIP_CONFIG_FILE=os.devnull + --no-input + --keyring-provider=disabled; do not change HOME; verify captured actual pip args/env by pure DI.

findings.meaning: MultiDomainBasicAuth._get_new_credentials defaults allow_netrc=True and calls get_netrc_auth before optional keyring.
Explicit NETRC selects only that path; otherwise ~/.netrc and ~/_netrc are expanded. An empty explicit private file therefore prevents home netrc fallback.
Config-file loading occurs even when isolated. PIP_CONFIG_FILE=os.devnull is read specially and skips all config files before reading them.
no_input controls auth.prompting and keyring_provider option configures the credential backend.

qualification: Read-only installed library source inspection. No existing credential file/keyring read, no network/request/auth execution. Hosted runner pip version not measured.
